01 / About me

A marketer with a strategic mindset.

I hold a Bachelor’s degree in Digital Marketing from The Hashemite University and am currently pursuing a Master’s degree in Digital Marketing at Applied Science Private University in Jordan.

My experience spans digital marketing, social media management, paid advertising, content strategy, and commercial video production. I translate business objectives into practical plans, relevant content, and audience-focused campaigns.

I believe effective marketing goes beyond publishing content or generating engagement. It requires clear objectives, KPIs aligned with business goals, an understanding of consumer behavior, and continuous improvement informed by campaign analysis.

Alongside my professional work, I am interested in marketing research and consumer decision-making. I aim to connect evidence-based insights with everyday marketing challenges.

“Creative ideas attract attention. Strategic execution creates value. Data helps us understand the difference.”

Research interests

Bridging marketing theory and real-world practice.

My research interests include digital consumer behavior, social media and influencer marketing, advertising effectiveness, and marketing analytics. My long-term ambition is to collaborate on meaningful marketing research and contribute to high-quality studies in reputable peer-reviewed journals, including those indexed in Scopus.

I see research as an opportunity to challenge assumptions, evaluate evidence, understand consumer decision-making, and develop strategies grounded in reliable insights.
